53.challengeNarrative: "Batch-based systems are unscalable for AI: Context is always a step behind, escalations pile up and it's difficult to intervene in time."
53.challenge: Support teams relied on batch pipelines that kept AI context stale and out of sync. Agents switched between CRM, ticketing, email and chat while customers waited. AI agents act on streaming context to update CRM records, create tickets and trigger escalations — without batch delays and without human intervention for L1 queries.

54.headline: Hybrid and multicloud AI: An architecture pattern, not a compromise
54.subheadline: Six production deployments — Migrato, Bud Financial, Wikimedia Deutschland, Athena Intelligence, Edsvärd and ViClinic — show how IBM technologies turn hosting constraints into configurable choices

54.storyTheme: Hybrid and multicloud AI architecture with IBM watsonx.data, IBM Cloud, IBM HashiCorp Terraform and IBM watsonx Orchestrate
54.challengeNarrative: "A cloud-only design can force costly data movement, increase latency or require customers to replace systems that still perform critical work."
54.challenge: Enterprises rarely choose their infrastructure — system requirements do. Sensitive records stay in customer-controlled data centers. Payment loops require sub-millisecond responses. Regional regulations restrict where data is stored. Existing on-premises systems can't be replaced. A single-cloud approach fails all of these constraints simultaneously.
54.solutionNarrative: IBM technologies provide the connective tissue across hybrid and multicloud boundaries — letting teams place data and compute where requirements demand, with consistent governance and no application rebuilds.
54.solution: IBM watsonx.data provides governed data and vector retrieval across on-premises, IBM Cloud and other public clouds. IBM Cloud supplies scalable AI services consumed only where appropriate. IBM HashiCorp Terraform makes environments repeatable through infrastructure-as-code modules. IBM watsonx Orchestrate coordinates agents across hybrid environments. IBM watsonx.governance applies access, consent and audit rules consistently everywhere.
